notes: Prototype tuning for what the away team perceives (designer spec, Oct 2026). Not from the STA books. First-pass placeholder values.

baseVisionRange: how far (in tiles) every party member sees, all around (no view cone). When requireLineOfSight is true, tiles with blocksSight block it for every NPC (same test as NPC awareness). Designer decision (2026-10-20): requireLineOfSight is false so non-hostile NPCs stay visible through cover; hostile NPCs always need line of sight (partyKnowledge seesVisually). NPCs still use line of sight in awareness.json for their own vision. baseVisionRange raised to 40 so Deck 10 crew are visible from beam-in (was 11; every Deck 10 NPC was outside that). Not taken from any Attribute or Discipline.
Party members who are Defeated perceive nothing.

detectionSources: the ways the party can learn of something. identifies = the party learns what it is (e.g. 'Klingon Warrior'), not only that something is there (e.g. a life sign). Only visual is in use in this pass; the others are placeholders for later sensors, tricorders, hearing and scripted reveals.
